# ContentStudio

ContentStudio is a social media management platform for publishing, workspace collaboration, analytics, and social inbox workflows.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/content-studio/.

## Actions

- **Add Facebook Group Account**: Add a Facebook Group to a ContentStudio workspace through the manual connection flow.
- **Add Inbox Note**: Create an internal note on a ContentStudio Social Inbox conversation, optionally mentioning workspace users.
- **Add Post Comment**: Add a collaboration comment to a ContentStudio post, optionally mentioning workspace users.
- **Add Post Note**: Add an internal note to a ContentStudio post.
- **Bulk Set Inbox Elements Archived**: Archive or unarchive 1-100 ContentStudio Social Inbox elements in one provider batch.
- **Bulk Set Inbox Elements Status**: Set the workflow status of 1-100 ContentStudio Social Inbox elements to done or pending in one provider batch.
- **Connect Bluesky Account**: Connect a Bluesky profile directly to a ContentStudio workspace using its handle and a Bluesky app password.
- **Create Campaign**: Create a named, color-coded campaign in a ContentStudio workspace.
- **Create Inbox Tag**: Create a named, color-coded Social Inbox tag in a ContentStudio workspace.
- **Create Label**: Create a named, color-coded label in a ContentStudio workspace.
- **Create Post**: Create a draft, queued, content-category, or scheduled ContentStudio post with complete media, platform publishing, first-comment, label,…
- **Create Workspace**: Create a ContentStudio workspace with its required name, logo URL, and timezone.
- **Delete Campaign**: Permanently delete a campaign from a ContentStudio workspace.
- **Delete Inbox Comment**: Permanently delete one public ContentStudio Social Inbox comment from its connected social platform.
- **Delete Inbox Message**: Soft-delete one ContentStudio Social Inbox message from its connected platform account.
- **Delete Inbox Review Reply**: Permanently delete the business reply from one ContentStudio Social Inbox review.
- **Delete Inbox Tags**: Permanently delete one or more ContentStudio Social Inbox tags by ID.
- **Delete Label**: Permanently delete a label from a ContentStudio workspace.
- **Delete Post**: Permanently delete a ContentStudio post and optionally attempt deletion from selected or all social accounts where it was published.
- **Delete Workspace**: Permanently delete a workspace and its workspace-scoped state.
- **Get AI Insights** (read-only): Generate AI analytics insights for one connected Facebook, GMB, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, TikTok, or YouTube account using one of…
- **Get Analytics Summary** (read-only): Return current-versus-previous summary KPIs for one connected Facebook, GMB, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, TikTok, Twitter, or YouTube…
- **Get Audience Demographics** (read-only): Return a supported Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, or YouTube audience demographics report through one of eight fixed ContentStudio routes.
- **Get Audience Growth Analytics** (read-only): Return audience, follower, or subscriber growth for one connected social account through an explicit platform, report, and granularity…
- **Get Content Analytics** (read-only): Get analytics for one platform-native Facebook, GMB, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, TikTok, Twitter, or YouTube content item.
- **Get Current User** (read-only): Return the active ContentStudio user associated with the connected API key.
- **Get Engagement Analytics** (read-only): Return active-user, impression, engagement, action, page-view, view, or watch-time analytics from one of 21 fixed ContentStudio routes.
- **Get GMB Activity Analytics** (read-only): Return Google Business Profile search-keyword, review, or media-activity analytics from one of exactly three documented routes.
- **Get Inbox Contact** (read-only): Get the contact profile associated with a ContentStudio Social Inbox element.
- **Get Media Performance Analytics** (read-only): Return Facebook reel/video, Instagram hashtag/story/reel, or LinkedIn hashtag performance through one of six fixed ContentStudio routes.
- **Get Publishing Analytics** (read-only): Return publishing behavior, posting cadence, pin rollups, YouTube discovery or sharing, or performance-schedule analytics from one of 12…
- **Get Twitter Credits Used** (read-only): Return Twitter/X API credits consumed by one connected account over a date range.
- **Invite Team Member**: Invite a team or client member to a ContentStudio workspace with a role and the provider's exact structured permission map.
- **List Approval Workflows** (read-only): List published approval workflows available in a ContentStudio workspace.
- **List Campaigns** (read-only): List or search campaigns in a ContentStudio workspace and return campaign IDs for post assignment.
- **List Connection Platforms** (read-only): List every social platform supported by ContentStudio account connection and identify whether each uses OAuth, credentials, or a manual…
- **List Content Categories** (read-only): List or search content categories in a ContentStudio workspace and return category IDs usable when targeting posts.
- **List Facebook Text Backgrounds** (read-only): List every Facebook colored-text background preset ID usable in facebook_options on plain-text posts.
- **List Inbox Conversation Content** (read-only): List messages, internal notes, or bookmarked messages for one ContentStudio Social Inbox conversation.
- **List Inbox Post Comments** (read-only): List public Social Inbox comment threads for a platform post reference.
- **List Inbox Tags** (read-only): List all Social Inbox tags in a ContentStudio workspace.
- **List Labels** (read-only): List or search labels in a ContentStudio workspace.
- **List Media** (read-only): List and filter media-library assets in a ContentStudio workspace.
- **List Post Comments** (read-only): List collaboration comments and internal notes on a ContentStudio post.
- **List Posts** (read-only): List ContentStudio workspace posts using status, date, approval, label, campaign, content-category, creator, and comment-state filters.
- **List Ranked Content Analytics** (read-only): List one offset-paginated page of top, least-performing, sorted, or pin-performance content analytics for one connected account.
- **List Social Accounts** (read-only): List connected social accounts in a ContentStudio workspace.
- **List Team Members** (read-only): List or search team members in a ContentStudio workspace and return user and membership IDs, roles, memberships, and available permissions.
- **List Workspaces** (read-only): List workspaces accessible to the connected account and return workspace IDs for workspace-scoped tools.
- **Mark Inbox Element Read**: Mark one ContentStudio Social Inbox element as read.
- **Merge Inbox Tags**: Irreversibly replace at least two ContentStudio Social Inbox source tags with one tag using the requested name and color.
- **Remove Social Account**: Disconnect a social account from a ContentStudio workspace.
- **Remove Team Member**: Permanently remove a member from a ContentStudio workspace.
- **Reply To Inbox Review**: Publish a public business reply to a ContentStudio Social Inbox review, replacing its existing reply when one exists.
- **Review Post Approval**: Approve or reject a ContentStudio post that is under review, optionally recording a review comment.
- **Search Inbox Elements** (read-only): Search one page of ContentStudio Social Inbox conversations, posts, and reviews using status, text, tag, channel, and targeted-element…
- **Send Inbox Comment**: Publish a public comment or reply on a ContentStudio Social Inbox post.
- **Send Inbox Message**: Send a Facebook or Instagram direct message through ContentStudio Social Inbox, optionally with one image or video attachment.
- **Send Inbox Private Reply**: Send a Facebook private reply from a ContentStudio Social Inbox post as a private message, optionally with an attachment.
- **Set Inbox Comment Hidden**: Hide or unhide one ContentStudio Social Inbox comment.
- **Set Inbox Comment Liked**: Like or unlike one ContentStudio Social Inbox comment.
- **Set Inbox Message Bookmarked**: Bookmark or unbookmark one ContentStudio Social Inbox message.
- **Summarize Inbox Elements** (read-only): Count ContentStudio Social Inbox conversations, posts, and reviews by all, unassigned, mine, assigned, marked-done, and archived states,…
- **Update Campaign**: Update a campaign's name or color.
- **Update Inbox Contact**: Partially update the name, email, phone, or company of the contact associated with a ContentStudio Social Inbox element.
- **Update Inbox Element Tags**: Add one or more tags to a ContentStudio Inbox element or remove one tag from it.
- **Update Inbox Tag**: Update a ContentStudio Social Inbox tag's name or color.
- **Update Label**: Update a label's name or color.
- **Update Post**: Fully replace an unpublished post's content, accounts, scheduling, platform options, labels, campaign, and approval configuration.
- **Update Team Member**: Replace a workspace member's role and complete permission map, and optionally replace their team or client membership class.
- **Update Workspace**: Update selected settings of an existing workspace.
- **Upload Media**: Upload one media file or import one public media URL into a ContentStudio workspace media library.
